This page is what an AI agent needs to author a Fluxion document: the cheat sheet, then the catalog of every shape, layout, theme and
marker it may name, then a complete example. The diagnostic codes the compiler answers with are in
[FluxScript diagnostics](/fluxion/reference/fluxscript-diagnostics/).

## FluxScript cheat sheet

You state intent; the engine places and routes. Never write coordinates unless you must pin a box.

### A document (YAML, flux: 1)

```yaml
flux: 1
title: Support ticket triage
uses: [basic]
screens:
  - id: triage
    title: Triaging a ticket
    layout: { type: layered, direction: right }
    nodes:
      new:    { shape: ellipse, label: Ticket received, tone: accent }
      urgent: { shape: diamond, label: How urgent? }
      page:   { shape: rounded-rect, label: Page on-call }
      queue:  { shape: rounded-rect, label: Add to the queue }
      close:  { shape: ellipse, label: Closed, pin: { x: 900, y: 300 } }
    edges:
      - new -> urgent
      - urgent -> page: now
      - urgent -> queue: later
      - page -> close
      - queue -> close: { label: done, route: orthogonal }
```

### Keys

- top: flux, title, theme, uses, lineJumps (true: lines hop where they cross), screens
- theme: preset, name, overrides
- screen: id, title, layout, template, items, options, background, nodes, groups, edges, notes
- node: shape, text, label, tone, style, pin, alt (node names are slugs: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens)
- group: label, contains, style, layout
- edge: "a -> b: label" or { from, to, op, label, style, route, jumps: arc|gap|none }; ops are -> <- <-> -- ~>; an end may name an anchor: a.e -> b.w
- pin: { x, y, w?, h? } keeps a box where you put it

### Rules

- Shape names resolve through uses: (rounded-rect for basic:rounded-rect when unique); use the catalog's ids.
- Style by token name (tone: accent), not by colour.
- Each screen compiles on its own. Omit layout to get layered.
- For a process, cycle, hierarchy, pyramid, matrix, venn, funnel, timeline or comparison, give a screen `template: <id>` and `items: [Plan, Build]` (strings, or { label, detail, children }), `options:` optional; the catalog lists the templates.
- Fix diagnostics by their hint; the path is a JSON pointer into the file.

### Edit with a patch (JSON)

`{ "flux": 1, "baseRevision": "r41", "ops": [ ... ] }` applies all ops or none. Refs are slugs, #<RecordId>, or edge keys a->b.

- add: { op, screen, slug, node, parent? }
- update: { op, target, set } (an edge target sets label, style, route, jumps; jumps: default clears)
- remove: { op, target, cascade? }
- connect: { op, edge: "a -> b: label", spec?: { label?, style?, route?, jumps? } }
- disconnect: { op, target }
- setLayout: { op, scope, layout: { type, direction?, spacing?, gap?, columns?, ... }, relayout? }; a template: layout: { type: template, id, items, options? } on a screen
- restyle: { op, targets: [refs] or { select: { screen?, shape?, tone?, kind? } }, style }
- addStep: { op, screen, at?, step }
- addInteraction: { op, owner, rule }

## Fluxion catalog

### Shapes

- `basic:block-arrow` (basic): A thick arrow block pointing right, for flows, steps and calls to action.; params: head:number=0.35, shaft:number=0.5
- `basic:callout` (basic): A speech-bubble box with a pointer, for comments and annotations.; params: tail:number=0.25, tip:number=0.25, width:number=0.15
- `basic:cloud` (basic): A cloud outline, for the internet, a cloud service or a vague area.
- `basic:cylinder` (basic): A can: the classic database or storage symbol.; params: depth:number=0.15
- `basic:diamond` (basic): A rhombus, the decision point of a flowchart.
- `basic:document` (basic): A page with a wavy bottom edge, for files, reports and documents.; params: wave:number=0.1
- `basic:ellipse` (basic): An ellipse or circle, for start and end points, states and actors.
- `basic:freehand` (basic): A hand-drawn stroke along points the author draws.; params: stroke:points=[[0,0.5],[0.25,0.2],[0.5,0.5],[0.75,0.8],[1,0.5]]
- `basic:hexagon` (basic): A six-sided shape, for preparation steps, services and cells.; params: inset:number=0.25
- `basic:image-frame` (basic): A rectangular frame that holds an image.
- `basic:line` (basic): A plain line between two points, with no connector behaviour.
- `basic:note` (basic): A sticky note with a folded corner, for remarks.; params: fold:number=0.2
- `basic:octagon` (basic): An eight-sided shape, for stop signs and terminators.; params: cut:number=0.29
- `basic:parallelogram` (basic): A slanted box, the input and output step of a flowchart.; params: skew:number=0.2
- `basic:polyline` (basic): An open or closed shape through points the author chooses.; params: vertices:points=[[0,1],[0.35,0],[0.65,1],[1,0]]
- `basic:rect` (basic): A rectangle, the default box for a component, step or service.
- `basic:rounded-rect` (basic): A rectangle with rounded corners, a friendly box for steps and cards.; params: r:number=12
- `basic:star` (basic): A star with a chosen number of points, for ratings and highlights.; params: points:int=5, inner:number=0.5
- `basic:text-box` (basic): A box that is only text, with no border or fill by default.
- `basic:trapezoid` (basic): A box with slanted sides, for manual steps and funnels.; params: inset:number=0.2
- `basic:triangle` (basic): A triangle, for warnings, hierarchies and play buttons.; params: apex:number=0.5

### Connector end markers

- `basic:crows-foot-many` (basic): Entity-relationship: one or many (a crow's foot and a bar).
- `basic:crows-foot-one` (basic): Entity-relationship: exactly one (two bars).
- `basic:crows-foot-zero-many` (basic): Entity-relationship: zero or many (a ring and a crow's foot).
- `basic:crows-foot-zero-one` (basic): Entity-relationship: zero or one (a ring and a bar).
- `basic:open-arrow` (basic): An open arrowhead (two strokes meeting at the tip).

### Layouts

- `circular` (core): Nodes evenly spaced on a circle, one circle per partition hint, for cycles and peer groups.; options: spacing, nodeGap, rankGap, padding
- `fit` (core): Fit to screen: keeps the arrangement, scaling it down and moving it into the safe area inside the screen edge.; options: margin
- `force` (core): Force-directed (seeded): linked boxes pull together and all others push apart, for networks without a direction.; options: iterations, spacing, nodeGap, padding
- `grid` (core): Boxes in rows and columns, in reading order.; options: columns, gap, align, padding
- `layered` (core): Flow layout by layers along the edges, for diagrams with direction.; options: direction, spacing, nodeGap, rankGap, padding
- `mindmap` (core): Mind map: the root in the middle and its branches on two balanced sides, right and left.; options: spacing, nodeGap, rankGap, padding
- `orgchart` (core): Organisation chart: a tidy tree whose leaf siblings stack in one column under their manager.; options: direction, spacing, nodeGap, rankGap, padding, compactLeaves
- `packing` (core): Packed: boxes fill the frame row by row on a skyline, largest first, for collections without links.; options: spacing, nodeGap, padding
- `radial` (core): Tree on rings around its root, one ring per depth, for hierarchies seen from the centre.; options: spacing, nodeGap, rankGap, padding
- `stack` (core): Boxes in one row or column, with an even gap.; options: direction, gap, align, padding, wrap
- `swimlane` (core): Swimlanes: a layered flow inside each lane hint, the lanes stacked as bands.; options: direction, spacing, nodeGap, rankGap, padding
- `tidy` (core): Tidy up: keeps the boxes where they are, aligns near-aligned ones, snaps to the grid and removes overlaps with bounded moves.; options: grid, tolerance, maxMove
- `timeline` (core): Timeline: events in date order along one axis, one band per lane hint.; options: direction, spacing, nodeGap, rankGap, padding
- `tree` (core): Tidy tree along the edges, for hierarchies with boxes of any size.; options: direction, spacing, nodeGap, rankGap, padding, compactLeaves

### Templates

- `comparison` (core): A comparison of two options: each a header over its points, side by side (stacked in a portrait frame).; options: direction, gap, spacing, padding, colors
- `cycle.basic` (core): A repeating cycle: items on a circle, clockwise from the top, each arrow leading to the next.; options: padding, colors
- `funnel` (core): A funnel: stages as bars narrowing from top to bottom, for conversion or filtering steps.; options: gap, narrowest, padding, colors
- `hierarchy.org` (core): An org chart or tree: each item above its children, joined to each of them.; options: gap, levelGap, padding, colors
- `matrix.2x2` (core): A 2 x 2 matrix: exactly four items as quadrants, top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right.; options: gap, padding, colors
- `process.basic` (core): Steps in order joined by arrows, left to right or top to bottom.; options: direction, gap, padding, colors
- `process.chevron` (core): Steps in order as chevron arrows pointing to the next, left to right.; options: gap, padding, colors
- `pyramid` (core): A pyramid of layers, the first item at the apex: foundations at the base, the few at the top.; options: gap, padding, colors
- `timeline.milestones` (core): A timeline: milestones in order along a line, labels alternating sides, left to right or top to bottom.; options: direction, padding, colors
- `venn` (core): A Venn diagram: two or three overlapping, see-through circles, for what sets share.; options: padding, opacity, colors

## Examples

The corpus in `examples/dsl/`: `brand-theme.flux.yaml`, `checkout.flux.yaml`, `edge-ops.flux.yaml`, `layered-flow.flux.yaml`, `order-flowchart.flux.yaml`, `pinned-dashboard.flux.yaml`, `platform-architecture.flux.yaml`, `release-notes.flux.yaml`, `routing-showcase.flux.yaml`, `style-tokens.flux.yaml`, `templates-all.flux.yaml`, `templates.flux.yaml`. One in full:

```yaml flux
flux: 1
title: Support ticket triage
theme: light
uses: [basic]
screens:
  - id: triage
    title: Triaging a ticket
    # no layout: the screen is laid out by `layered`, which ranks the nodes along the edges
    nodes:
      new:     { shape: ellipse, label: Ticket received, tone: accent }
      urgent:  { shape: diamond, label: How urgent? }
      page:    { shape: rounded-rect, label: Page on-call }
      queue:   { shape: rounded-rect, label: Add to the queue }
      finance: { shape: rect, label: Hand to finance }
      reply:   { shape: document, label: Send a reply }
      close:   { shape: ellipse, label: Ticket closed }
    edges:
      - new -> urgent
      - urgent -> page: now
      - urgent -> queue: later
      - urgent -> finance: billing
      - page -> reply
      - queue -> reply
      - finance -> reply
      - reply -> close
    notes: |
      The three branches meet again at the reply: five ranks, three boxes wide.
      Nothing is pinned, so every box is placed by the layout.
```
